proposal.notes: This template documents the work needed to close FM-44 silent trace loss. It cannot usefully execute until the following infrastructure additions land: (1) activity-api must expose GET /v2/vessels/{vesselId}/execution-count?since=&until= returning the count of stored traces grouped by vessel_id over the window — without this, divergence cannot be measured; (2) ias-executor-ts TranslatingTraceSink (repos/ias-executor-ts/src/adapters/activity-api-trace-sink.ts:67-174) must persist failed POSTs to a durable on-disk outbox and run a background re-submitter — today non-2xx and transport errors are swallowed with no retry; (3) vessels must expose an outbox-status endpoint (e.g. GET /vessel/outbox/status returning {pending_count, oldest_pending_at, last_flush_at}) OR include outbox metrics in the heartbeat payload to discovery-vessel — task 4 below is inert until this exists; (4) the trace POST contract must accept an idempotency key (execution_id as natural key) and the activity-api UPSERT path must dedupe on it so redelivery is safe — without this, redelivery could double-write traces and over-count α. Until pieces (1)-(4) ship, this template runs in degraded mode: tasks 1-3 surface the gap using whatever local counters are reachable today (heartbeat metadata.executionsCompleted) versus a coarse activity-api COUNT(*) query, and tasks 4-6 emit empty/partial impulses with skip reasons. Each future cycle should land one piece and re-enable the corresponding task.

template.name: Trace Redelivery Monitor
template.description: Detect silent execution-trace loss by comparing each vessel's self-reported executionsCompleted counter against activity-api's stored trace count over a rolling time window. Flag vessels with >5% sustained gap, inspect their local outbox if reachable, emit a traceLossReport, and (when infrastructure permits) request redelivery. This activity is the FM-44 closure: it converts a silent FN at the learning stage into an observable, actionable signal so Thompson posteriors stop under-counting.

tasks.description: Query discovery-vessel registry for all live vessels and read each vessel's self-reported executionsCompleted counter from its most recent heartbeat metadata over the audit window.

config.extract_path: vessels[].{vessel_id: id, declared_count: heartbeat.metrics.executionsCompleted, heartbeat_at: heartbeat.timestamp}

tasks.description: Query activity-api for the count of stored execution traces grouped by vessel_id over the same time window.

fallback_if_endpoint_missing.skip_reason: GET /v2/vessels/{vesselId}/execution-count not yet implemented on activity-api; emit partial coverage flag and continue with 0 stored_count per vessel

tasks.description: Join declared vs stored counts per vessel, compute gap_pct = (declared - stored) / max(declared, 1), and flag vessels where gap_pct > 0.05 sustained across the window.
For each flagged vessel, query its outbox-status endpoint (or read outbox metrics from heartbeat) to learn pending trace count and oldest pending timestamp.

fallback_if_endpoint_missing.skip_reason: Vessel does not expose /vessel/outbox/status; emit outbox_size_if_known=null and rely solely on declared-vs-stored gap

tasks.description: Compose the final traceLossReport listing per-vessel (vessel_id, declared_count, stored_count, gap_pct, outbox_size_if_known, recommended_action).

compose.recommended_action_per_vessel: if outbox_size_if_known > 0 then 'request_redelivery' else if outbox_size_if_known == null then 'add_outbox_endpoint' else 'investigate_drop_path'

tasks.description: For flagged vessels with non-empty outbox AND idempotent trace-POST support, dispatch a redelivery request; otherwise emit a deferral note.

fallback_if_capability_missing.skip_reason: Activity-api trace POST does not yet accept execution_id as idempotency key; redelivery would risk double-counting α. Defer until idempotency lands.
